title: Canonical pure-tensor sections of scalar extension of module sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal R,\mathcal S$ be sheaves of commutative rings, let $a:\mathcal R\to\mathcal S$ be a morphism of ring sheaves, and let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $a_!M$ be the sheaf of $\mathcal S$-modules associated to the presheaf $V\mapsto\mathcal S(V)\otimes_{\mathcal R(V)}M(V)$, with scalar action through $a_V$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every object $V$ of $\mathcal C$, $x\in M(V)$ and $s\in\mathcal S(V)$, define the canonical pure-tensor section $\operatorname{tmul}_{a,M,V}(x,s)=\eta_{a,M,V}(s\otimes x)\in(a_!M)(V)$, where $\eta_{a,M}$ is the module-sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. The order of the arguments is $(x,s)$, while the scalar is the first tensor factor; equivalently this is the image of $x\otimes s$ after the canonical factor interchange. This definition applies to every $a$, without assuming it is invertible or flat.
